Let
\[
S=\sum_{n=1}^\infty\sum_{k=1}^\infty \frac{\mho(n,k)}{3^{n+k-7}}
=2187\sum_{n=1}^\infty\sum_{k=1}^\infty \frac{\mho(n,k)}{3^{n+k}}.
\]
Since \(\mho(n,k)=\sum_{p\mid n,\ p\ge k}1\), we interchange sums:
\[
S=2187\sum_{p\text{ prime}}\sum_{\substack{n\ge 1\\p\mid n}}\sum_{k=1}^p \frac1{3^{n+k}}.
\]
Now
\[
\sum_{\substack{n\ge1\\p\mid n}}\frac1{3^n}
=\sum_{m=1}^\infty \frac1{3^{pm}}
=\frac{3^{-p}}{1-3^{-p}},
\]
and
\[
\sum_{k=1}^p \frac1{3^k}
=\frac12(1-3^{-p}).
\]
Thus each prime contributes \(\frac12 3^{-p}\), so
\[
S=\frac{2187}{2}\sum_{p\text{ prime}}3^{-p}.
\]
Compute:
\[
2187\sum_{p\text{ prime}}3^{-p}
=3^7\left(\frac1{3^2}+\frac1{3^3}+\frac1{3^5}+\frac1{3^7}+\cdots\right)
=243+81+9+1+\frac1{81}+\frac1{729}+\cdots
\approx 334.0137.
\]
Hence
\[
S\approx \frac{334.0137}{2}=167.00685.
\]
The closest integer is \(\boxed{167}\).
